title.zh: 黎曼猜想的 Lean 形式化验证
title.en: Lean verification of the Riemann Hypothesis

summary.zh: Lean 社区博客发布文章，介绍对黎曼猜想所做的 Lean 形式化验证工作，在 Hacker News 获得 860 分、720 条评论。讨论主要集中在这项工作究竟证明了什么，以及形式化数学目前的进展与局限。
summary.en: A Lean Prover community blog post on verifying the Riemann Hypothesis drew heavy Hacker News attention (860 points, 720 comments). Discussion centered on what the formalization actually establishes and the current state of formalized mathematics.

reports.title: Lean verification of the Riemann Hypothesis
The stochastic parrots have apparently proved the Riemann Hypothesis

title.zh: 化石燃料之争使COP31气候谈判陷入僵局
title.en: Fight over fossil fuels leaves COP31 climate talks in deadlock

summary.zh: 近200个国家在COP31气候大会上就达成新的全球气候协议陷入僵局。化石燃料分歧是主要障碍。
summary.en: Nearly 200 countries remain deadlocked at COP31 climate talks over a new global climate agreement. Disagreements over fossil fuels are blocking progress.

reports.title: Fight over fossil fuels leaves COP31 climate talks in deadlock

title.zh: 治疗胰腺癌的口服药片被誉为“数十年来最大突破”
title.en: Pill to treat pancreatic cancer hailed as 'biggest breakthrough in decades'

summary.zh: 《卫报》报道称，口服药物 daraxonrasib 在胰腺癌治疗上取得突破，被评价为数十年来最重要的进展。该消息在技术社区引发广泛关注，讨论聚焦于疗效数据与后续审批前景。
summary.en: The Guardian reports that the oral drug daraxonrasib has been hailed as the biggest advance in pancreatic cancer treatment in decades. The news drew wide attention online, with discussion focused on efficacy data and regulatory prospects.

reports.title: Pill to treat pancreatic cancer hailed as 'biggest breakthrough in decades'

title.zh: 纳维-斯托克斯方程的有限时间爆破
title.en: Finite-time blow-up for the Navier–Stokes equations

summary.zh: 一份 GitHub 仓库发布关于纳维-斯托克斯方程有限时间爆破的工作，该问题属于千禧年数学难题之一。相关工作尚待同行评议，社区讨论集中在证明思路与验证难度上。
summary.en: A GitHub repository presents work on finite-time blow-up for the Navier–Stokes equations, one of the Millennium Prize Problems. The result awaits peer review, with discussion focused on the proof strategy and how it might be verified.

reports.title: Finite-time blow-up for the Navier–Stokes equations

title.zh: 联合国未能就监管“杀手机器人”的规则达成一致
title.en: The UN fails to agree on rules regulating 'killer robots'

summary.zh: 在日内瓦举行的联合国谈判中，各国代表未能就自主武器（即所谓“杀手机器人”）的使用规则达成协议。经过一周基本无果的磋商，各方仅同意“开始讨论各种选项”。
summary.en: UN diplomats meeting in Geneva failed to agree on rules governing autonomous weapons, so-called "killer robots." After a largely fruitless week of negotiations, representatives only agreed to "start discussing options."

reports.title: The UN fails to agree on rules regulating ‘killer robots’

title.zh: 一艘驶往俄罗斯的船只在芬兰湾遭袭
title.en: Russia-bound ship attacked in Gulf of Finland

summary.zh: 芬兰国防军称，一艘驶往俄罗斯的船只在芬兰湾遭到无人机袭击。芬方表示，乌克兰很可能是此次袭击的幕后黑手。
summary.en: Finland’s defence forces said a Russia-bound ship was attacked by drones in the Gulf of Finland. They said Ukraine was likely behind the attack.

reports.title: Russia-bound ship attacked in Gulf of Finland

title.zh: 联合国自主武器管控谈判破裂
title.en: International UN talks on controlling use of autonomous weapons collapse

summary.zh: 在日内瓦《特定常规武器公约》会议上，为期一周的谈判因俄罗斯反对而未能就制定具有法律约束力条约的谈判授权达成一致。尽管绝大多数国家支持启动谈判，会谈仍在通宵后破裂。
summary.en: Week-long UN talks in Geneva on a legally binding treaty to control autonomous weapons collapsed after all-night negotiations failed to overcome Russian objections. Despite overwhelming support among states for a negotiating mandate, no agreement was reached.

reports.title: International UN talks on controlling use of autonomous weapons collapse

title.zh: 泽连斯基称袭击克里米亚大桥是“公平回应” 并会见英国官员斯特里廷
title.en: Zelensky says Crimean Bridge strikes 'fair response' as he meets UK's Streeting

summary.zh: 泽连斯基称，乌克兰对克里米亚大桥的打击是“公平回应”，因为俄方此前对乌克兰桥梁发动了109次空袭。他在会见到访的英国官员斯特里廷时作出上述表态。
summary.en: Ukraine’s president said strikes on the Crimean Bridge were a “fair response,” after 109 separate Russian aerial attacks on bridges in Ukraine. He spoke while meeting UK’s Streeting.

reports.title: Zelensky says Crimean Bridge strikes 'fair response' as he meets UK's Streeting

title.zh: 中国承诺推进低碳电气化并帮助他国改进
title.en: China commits to low-carbon electrification and help for others to improve

summary.zh: 中国代表团高级成员在COP31表示，中国将推动经济快速电气化并采用低碳能源，同时帮助其他国家实现类似转型。会议还呼吁各国承诺到2035年将35%的能源来自电力。
summary.en: A senior Chinese delegate at COP31 said China is pushing rapid low-carbon electrification and will help other countries do the same. The summit is urging countries to commit to deriving 35% of energy from electricity by 2035.

reports.title: China commits to low-carbon electrification and help for others to improve

title.zh: 特朗普威胁对在海外建数据中心的美国科技公司实施“巨额处罚”
title.en: Trump threatens ‘tremendous penalties’ for US tech firms that build datacenters abroad

summary.zh: 特朗普在白宫记者会上威胁对在美国境外建设数据中心的美国科技公司施加“巨额处罚”，但未提供细节。他还称尚未告知本国官员，并表示将“调查”有关伊朗的报道。
summary.en: Trump threatened “tremendous penalties” on US tech companies building datacenters abroad, without giving details. He said he had not yet informed his own officials and would “look into” a report about Iran.

reports.title: Trump threatens ‘tremendous penalties’ for US tech firms that build datacenters abroad

title.zh: 消息人士：美国 SEC 对英伟达的调查正在审视潜在会计问题
title.en: US SEC's Nvidia probe is examining potential accounting issues – sources

summary.zh: 据消息人士称，美国证券交易委员会对英伟达的调查正在审查潜在的会计问题。相关报道未披露更多细节，市场关注调查是否会影响公司财报口径与股价表现。
summary.en: Sources say the US Securities and Exchange Commission's probe into Nvidia is examining potential accounting issues. Few details were disclosed, with investors watching whether the inquiry affects the company's reported figures or share price.

reports.title: US SEC's Nvidia probe is examining potential accounting issues – sources
美国证券交易委员会据悉正对英伟达潜在会计问题展开调查 - Jiemian.com
英伟达再遭SEC调查，会计问题是审查重点，股价已较10月高点腰斩 - 华尔街见闻

title.zh: 特朗普称只应向中国出售较旧款芯片
title.en: Trump says only older chips should be sold to China - Reuters

summary.zh: 据路透社报道，特朗普表示美国只应允许向中国出售较老一代的芯片，暗示对更先进半导体出口的限制将继续维持。相关表态或影响美方对华芯片出口政策走向。
summary.en: Trump said only older-generation chips should be sold to China, according to Reuters, suggesting curbs on more advanced semiconductors would continue. The remark signals the direction of US export policy toward Beijing.

reports.title: Trump says only older chips should be sold to China - Reuters

title.zh: Signal 限制手机端截图，以应对 AI 监控的“生存威胁”
title.en: Signal restricts mobile screenshots as it confronts ‘existential threat’ of AI surveillance

summary.zh: 加密通讯应用 Signal 开始在 Android 与 iOS 客户端限制用户截图功能。该举措被视为应对 AI 驱动的监控与内容抓取风险的防御性调整。
summary.en: Signal is limiting screenshot capabilities in its Android and iOS apps. The move is framed as a defense against AI-driven surveillance and content scraping risks.

reports.title: Signal restricts mobile screenshots as it confronts ‘existential threat’ of AI surveillance

title.zh: Inkling-2-Mini 可在 5.4 GB 内存中运行
title.en: Inkling-2-Mini in 5.4 GB Memory

summary.zh: 有开发者在 GitHub 发布项目，展示模型 Inkling-2-Mini 能在 5.4 GB 内存环境下运行，该帖在技术社区获得较高关注。讨论主要围绕低资源部署的可行性与实际性能表现。
summary.en: A developer's GitHub project demonstrates running the Inkling-2-Mini model within 5.4 GB of memory, drawing substantial interest on Hacker News. Discussion focused on the feasibility of low-resource deployment and real-world performance.

reports.title: Inkling-2-Mini in 5.4 GB Memory

title.zh: FBI十大通缉犯之一墨西哥毒枭在枪战中被捕
title.en: Mexican drug lord on FBI's 10 most wanted list arrested in shoot-out

summary.zh: 被控贩毒和酷刑的墨西哥籍嫌疑人福斯托·伊西德罗·梅萨·弗洛雷斯在與当局交火后被捕，其位列美国联邦调查局十大通缉要犯名单。美方此前曾悬赏征集其线索。
summary.en: Fausto Isidro "Chapo Isidro" Meza Flores, accused of drug trafficking and torture, was detained after a gun battle with authorities. He was on the FBI's ten most wanted list.

reports.title: Mexican drug lord on FBI's 10 most wanted list arrested in shoot-out
Alleged Mexican drug cartel boss ‘El Chapo Isidro’ arrested in special forces raid

title.zh: 金价跌势凌厉，多家银行发布紧急风险提示
title.en: Gold prices slump sharply, prompting emergency warnings from multiple banks

summary.zh: 财新报道，国际金价近期快速下跌，多家银行向客户发布紧急提示，提醒关注贵金属价格波动风险。分析人士认为，市场对利率路径与资金流向的预期变化是主要压力来源。
summary.en: Caixin reports that banks have issued urgent client warnings as gold prices fall steeply, flagging precious-metals volatility risk. Shifting expectations on interest rates and capital flows are seen as the main sources of pressure.

reports.title: 金价跌势凌厉，多家银行发布紧急提示 - 财新

title.zh: FBI据报调查其犯罪数据库疑遭黑客入侵事件
title.en: FBI reportedly investigating apparent hack of its criminal database

summary.zh: 据报道，美国联邦调查局正调查国家犯罪信息中心数据库疑似遭黑客入侵一事。该数据库供联邦与地方执法机构共享案件与人员信息，事件影响范围尚待评估。
summary.en: The FBI is reportedly investigating an apparent hack of the National Crime Information Center database, which federal and local law enforcement use to share information. The scope of any breach was not immediately clear.

reports.title: FBI reportedly investigating apparent hack of its criminal database
Trump says there could be a 'positive spin' from the latest FBI database hack

title.zh: Anthropic创纪录IPO撞上华尔街科技股2020年以来最惨一周
title.en: Anthropic’s record IPO collides with tech’s worst week on Wall Street since 2020

summary.zh: Anthropic在纳斯达克完成历史性上市，次日英伟达股价收官，创下2008年以来最长周线连跌纪录。新股发行与科技板块整体回调同时发生，市场情绪承压。
summary.en: Anthropic held its historic Nasdaq debut a day before Nvidia closed out its longest weekly losing streak since 2008. The record listing landed as the broader tech sector suffered its worst week on Wall Street since 2020.

reports.title: Anthropic’s record IPO collides with tech’s worst week on Wall Street since 2020
4万亿“灰飞烟灭”、疫情以来最惨烈的一周！美国科技股跌入熊市 - 华尔街见闻

title.zh: 独家：丹麦在挫败图谋后推动欧盟收紧对俄人员旅行限制
title.en: EXCLUSIVE: Denmark pushes EU to tighten travel curbs on Russians after foiled plot - Reuters

summary.zh: 据路透社独家报道，在挫败一起图谋后，丹麦正推动欧盟收紧对俄罗斯公民的旅行限制。相关讨论涉及申根区入境规则，具体措施仍待成员国协商。
summary.en: Denmark is pushing the EU to tighten travel restrictions on Russian citizens after a plot was foiled, Reuters reported exclusively. Discussions concern Schengen entry rules, with specifics still subject to member-state negotiation.

reports.title: EXCLUSIVE: Denmark pushes EU to tighten travel curbs on Russians after foiled plot - Reuters

title.zh: 软银孙正义曾探讨以1万亿美元收购SK海力士
title.en: SoftBank’s Son explored $1 trillion buyout of SK Hynix, the Information reports - Reuters

summary.zh: 据The Information报道，软银集团创始人孙正义曾探讨以约1万亿美元收购韩国存储芯片厂商SK海力士。报道未说明该构想是否已推进或终止，软银与SK海力士均未公开确认。
summary.en: SoftBank founder Masayoshi Son explored a roughly $1 trillion buyout of South Korean memory chipmaker SK Hynix, The Information reported, according to Reuters. It was unclear whether the idea advanced, and neither company publicly confirmed it.

reports.title: SoftBank’s Son explored $1 trillion buyout of SK Hynix, the Information reports - Reuters
融资收购SK海力士？孙正义一度考虑“万亿豪赌”，已接洽华尔街 - 华尔街见闻

title.zh: 两个截然不同的英伟达
title.en: A tale of two Nvidias

summary.zh: 英伟达最新财报与部分科技高管公开呼吁黄仁勋回归，呈现出关于这家公司的两种截然不同的图景。报道对比了财务表现与业界舆论之间的落差。
summary.en: Nvidia's latest earnings report and tech executives publicly calling for Jensen Huang's return paint two very different pictures of the company. The piece contrasts financial results with industry sentiment.

reports.title: A tale of two Nvidias

title.zh: Anthropic 能否负担“安全优先”？
title.en: Can Anthropic afford to put safety first?

summary.zh: The Verge 播客讨论 Anthropic 上市后的处境：Claude 背后的 AI 实验室已登陆纳斯达克。节目聚焦其巨额估值与坚持安全优先之间的张力。
summary.en: The Verge's podcast examines Anthropic after its Nasdaq listing. The discussion focuses on the tension between its huge valuation and its stated commitment to putting safety first.

reports.title: Can Anthropic afford to put safety first?

title.zh: 今年流感跨毒株感染风险加大，流感季三毒株同时活跃
title.en: Cross-strain flu infection risk rises this year as three strains circulate at once

summary.zh: 据界面新闻报道，今年流感季有三种流感毒株同时流行，公众同时感染不同毒株的风险上升。报道提示，多毒株共同活跃可能加大防控与诊治难度，需关注疫苗接种与个人防护。
summary.en: Three influenza strains are circulating simultaneously this season, raising the risk of cross-strain infection, Jiemian.com reported. The co-circulation may complicate prevention, diagnosis and treatment, highlighting the need for vaccination and personal precautions.

reports.title: 今年流感跨毒株感染风险加大，今年流感季三毒株同时活跃 - Jiemian.com

title.zh: Pandex：面向 AI 智能体的欧洲官方法律框架，基于 MCP
title.en: Pandex – Official European Law for AI Agents, over MCP

summary.zh: 一则技术社区分享介绍了 Pandex 项目，称其为面向 AI 智能体、基于 MCP 协议的欧洲法律框架。该条目在 Hacker News 获得少量讨论。
summary.en: A Hacker News submission introduces Pandex, described as an official European legal framework for AI agents built over the MCP protocol. The post drew limited community discussion.

reports.title: Pandex – Official European Law for AI Agents, over MCP

title.zh: Upload2Shell 漏洞（CVE-2026-125396）
title.en: Upload2Shell (CVE-2026-125396)

summary.zh: 安全研究者公开披露编号 CVE-2026-125396 的漏洞，命名为 Upload2Shell，涉及文件上传导致远程命令执行。技术社区对该披露关注度较高。
summary.en: A security disclosure details CVE-2026-125396, dubbed Upload2Shell, involving file upload leading to remote code execution. The write-up drew substantial attention in technical communities.

reports.title: Upload2Shell (CVE-2026-125396)

title.zh: 加沙卫生部称以色列空袭一辆汽车致三人死亡
title.en: Israeli strike on vehicle in Gaza kills three, Gaza Health Ministry says - Reuters

summary.zh: 据路透社报道，加沙卫生部表示，以色列对加沙地带一辆汽车发动空袭，造成三人死亡。报道未提供更多细节，如死者身份或空袭发生地点。
summary.en: Gaza's health ministry said an Israeli strike on a vehicle in Gaza killed three people, Reuters reported. No further details, such as the identities of the dead or the location of the strike, were immediately provided.

reports.title: Israeli strike on vehicle in Gaza kills three, Gaza Health Ministry says - Reuters

title.zh: 萨尔瓦多部队打击帮派，海地民众既期待又不安
title.en: Haitians excited but uneasy as El Salvador troops fight gangs

summary.zh: 随着外国部队进驻太子港打击长期控制首都的武装帮派，许多海地民众表示欢迎，但也有人担心军事行动可能加剧当地本已动荡的局势。此前帮派暴力使包括体育场在内的公共生活长期停摆。
summary.en: Foreign combatants, including Salvadoran troops, have been welcomed by many in Port-au-Prince after years of gang control of the capital. Some Haitians, however, fear the offensive could further destabilise an already volatile situation.

reports.title: Haitians excited but uneasy as El Salvador troops fight gangs

title.zh: 特朗普称普京为朋友后，泽连斯基称普京是“杀手”
title.en: Zelensky says Putin is a 'killer' after Trump calls Russian leader a friend

summary.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基称俄罗斯总统普京是“杀手”，此番表态是在美国总统特朗普称普京为朋友之后作出的。报道称，特朗普本周早些时候在中国的一场会晤前与普京打招呼，并称两人关系“很好”。
summary.en: Ukraine's Zelensky called Russia's Putin a "killer" after US President Trump described the Russian leader as a friend. Trump reportedly greeted Putin ahead of a meeting in China and said the two have a "great relationship."

reports.title: Zelensky says Putin is a 'killer' after Trump calls Russian leader a friend

title.zh: 我的显示器把下载速度砍掉了 75%
title.en: My monitor was cutting my download speed by 75%

summary.zh: 一名博主发现其 Studio Display 的以太网连接导致下载速度下降约 75%，并记录了排查过程。该文在技术社区引发大量讨论。
summary.en: A blogger traced a roughly 75 percent drop in download speed to the Ethernet link on a Studio Display. The troubleshooting write-up sparked wide discussion on Hacker News.

reports.title: My monitor was cutting my download speed by 75%

title.zh: 我们把开发者提拔成架构师，却没有告知他们
title.en: We promoted developers into architects without informing them

summary.zh: 一篇技术博客讨论团队将资深开发者悄然转入架构师角色、却未事先说明职责变化的现象，分析由此产生的角色混淆与沟通缺失，并在 Hacker News 上引发近 600 点、300 多条评论的热议。
summary.en: A blog post describes how a team moved senior developers into architect roles without telling them, examining the role confusion and communication gaps that followed. The piece drew hundreds of comments on Hacker News.

reports.title: We promoted developers into architects without informing them

title.zh: 引爆一大堆叠氮化铅
title.en: Detonating a pile of lead azide

summary.zh: 《科学》杂志博客作者记录了引爆大量叠氮化铅的实验过程，介绍这种敏感起爆药的危险特性与安全操作要点。该文在 Hacker News 上获得 500 多点。
summary.en: A Science magazine blog post recounts detonating a large quantity of lead azide, describing the hazards and handling precautions of this highly sensitive primary explosive. The post drew wide attention on Hacker News.

reports.title: Detonating a pile of lead azide

title.zh: 陆家嘴金融沙龙：人工智能重塑公募投研新生态
title.en: Lujiazui financial salon: AI reshapes public fund research ecosystem

summary.zh: 第一财经报道，陆家嘴金融沙龙围绕人工智能如何重塑公募基金投研生态展开讨论，聚焦AI在数据处理、研究效率提升方面的应用观察，以及随之而来的合规、数据质量与投研责任等挑战。
summary.en: A Lujiazui salon hosted by Yicai discussed how AI is reshaping research at Chinese public fund managers, covering efficiency gains in data processing and research, along with challenges in compliance, data quality and accountability.

reports.title: 陆家嘴金融沙龙：人工智能重塑公募投研新生态——观察、机遇与挑战 - 第一财经

title.zh: 中国洗衣机为何未能打开15亿人的非洲市场
title.en: Why haven't Chinese washing machines conquered Africa's 1.5 billion-person market?

summary.zh: 界面新闻报道称，非洲人口约15亿，但中国洗衣机企业在该市场份额有限。报道分析认为，渠道成本、电力与供水条件、消费能力和本地化售后体系等因素制约了渗透率提升。
summary.en: Jiemian examines why Chinese washing machine makers hold limited share in Africa despite its 1.5 billion population. Distribution costs, unreliable power and water, low purchasing power and weak localized after-sales service are cited as barriers.

reports.title: 中国洗衣机，为什么没拿下15亿人的非洲市场？ - Jiemian.com

title.zh: Ask HN：我已失业两年，15 年经验，在美国，该怎么办？
title.en: Ask HN: I have been unemployed for 2y. 15 years of experience, US. What to do?

summary.zh: 一名有 15 年经验的美国资深软件工程师在 Hacker News 发帖求助，称自己已失业两年，积蓄几乎耗尽，仅够支撑家庭四五个月，目前靠做数学辅导和即将在披萨店任经理维生，询问下一步该如何打算。
summary.en: A US-based senior software engineer with 15 years of experience, including Fortune 50 and mid-size firms, asks Hacker News for advice after two years of unemployment. His savings are nearly gone, leaving about four to five months of household support, and he is tutoring math while preparing to manage a pizzeria.

reports.title: Ask HN: I have been unemployed for 2y. 15 years of experience, US. What to do?

title.zh: 美国解密更多中东拍摄的UFO影像
title.en: US declassifies more UFO footage filmed in the Middle East

summary.zh: 五角大楼公布第八批不明飞行物（UFO）相关记录，其中包括2020年、2023年和2026年在多哈拍摄的三段视频。这批解密材料进一步扩充了公众可查阅的未解目击事件档案。
summary.en: The Pentagon has released an eighth tranche of UFO records, including three video clips filmed in the Middle East in 2020, 2023 and 2026. The declassified material adds to a growing public archive of unexplained sightings.

reports.title: US declassifies more UFO footage filmed in the Middle East

title.zh: 财新观察｜亚太回答时代课题
title.en: Caixin Observer | Asia-Pacific answers the questions of our times

summary.zh: 财新发表评论文章，以“亚太回答时代课题”为题，讨论亚太地区面对当前共同挑战的应对之道。文章属评论性质，围绕区域合作与治理议题展开。
summary.en: Caixin published a commentary titled "Asia-Pacific answers the questions of our times," discussing how the region should respond to shared challenges. The piece is an opinion article focused on regional cooperation and governance issues.

title.zh: 神秘“暗彗星”加速之谜持续困扰天文学家
title.en: Weirdly accelerating space rock keeps puzzling astronomers

summary.zh: 被称为“暗彗星”的1998 KY26出现难以解释的加速运动，天文学家尚未完全弄清原因。日本探测器原计划2031年造访，但因发动机故障无法成行，谜团可能继续悬而未决。该案例或有助于理解小行星与彗星之间的非常规活动，值得关注后续研究。
summary.en: The dark comet 1998 KY26 is accelerating in a way astronomers do not fully understand. A Japanese probe was meant to visit it in 2031, but engine trouble has scuttled that encounter, leaving the mystery unresolved. The case is worth reading because it may expose unusual cometary or asteroidal processes.

title.zh: 《Checks and Balance》通讯：2028年总统竞选阵营拥挤
title.en: Checks and Balance newsletter: The crowded field for 2028

summary.zh: 《Checks and Balance》通讯聚焦2028年美国总统选举的拥挤潜在参选人阵容。美国编辑Charlotte Howard分析这些竞选者如何尝试在早期阶段脱颖而出。早期布局往往反映两党内部力量变化，值得跟踪。
summary.en: The Checks and Balance newsletter examines the crowded field of potential 2028 U.S. presidential candidates. U.S. editor Charlotte Howard looks at how hopefuls are trying to stand out early. It is worth reading for signals about party dynamics and early positioning.

title.zh: 真正的科技成瘾者
title.en: The real tech addicts

summary.zh: 文章探讨“真正的科技成瘾者”：为什么有些人会不断陷入数字兔子洞。它可能从心理、行为与平台设计等角度解释过度使用数字产品的原因。理解这一现象有助于区分个体选择与产品诱导，值得深入阅读。
summary.en: This piece asks who the real tech addicts are and why some people fall down the digital rabbit hole. It likely examines psychological, behavioral and platform-design factors behind excessive technology use. It is worth reading for a clearer view of personal choice versus product-driven compulsion.

title.zh: 其他行星闻起来是什么味？答案藏在化学里
title.en: What do other planets smell like? The answer hides in their chemistry

summary.zh: 我们或许永远无法亲自闻一闻其他行星，但它们的化学组成可以透露气味线索。文章从行星化学出发，推测不同世界可能散发的气味。这种跨学科视角兼具科学性与想象力，值得一读。
summary.en: We will probably never smell other planets, but their chemistry can offer clues about what they might be like. This article uses planetary chemistry to imagine the possible scents of other worlds. It is worth reading for a creative, science-based way to understand alien environments.
